candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record confirms Listeria monocytogenes bacteremia via positive blood culture with MALDI-TOF identification, and molecular typing (MLST) yielding ST87 with serovars 1/2b, 3b, 7. C001 correctly identifies listeriosis in pregnancy but lacks the ST87 strain specification and the explicit bacteremia characterization, both of which are required components of the benchmark reference.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures pregnancy-associated listeriosis with fever but omits the specific sequence type (ST87) and the bacteremia designation confirmed by positive blood culture

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis includes MLST-derived sequence type (ST87) which is a molecular epidemiological detail not routinely part of a clinical diagnosis; however, it is explicitly stated as a required component of the benchmark.
